description: SNCB GFTS - scheduled timetable and real-time data is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by NMBS/SNCB . Both the scheduled timetable and the real-time data are available to you for free. There are two GTFS feeds available: - The scheduled data which are updated daily - The real-time data which are updated every 30 seconds. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in GTFS. The data standards named are gtfs. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2026-09-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other-nc. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
